# generated from spec/capabilities/checklists.md by features generate; do not edit
Feature: Checklists
  Narrator: the person

  @g1 @r1
  Scenario: Create a checklist
    Given a checklist c1
    When the person creates the checklist c1 with a title
    Then the checklists service keeps the checklist c1
    And the checklists service returns the checklist c1

  @g2 @r2
  Scenario: Create a checklist without a title
    Given a checklist c1
    When the person creates the checklist c1 without a title
    Then the checklists service refuses this request
    And the checklists service names the title

  @g3 @r3
  Scenario: Create a checklist with a title in use
    Given a checklist c1
    And the title of the checklist c1 is `groceries`
    And a checklist c2
    When the person creates the checklist c2 with the title `groceries`
    Then the checklists service refuses this request
    And the checklists service names the title

  @g4 @r4
  Scenario: Add an item to a checklist
    Given an item i1
    And a checklist c1
    When the person adds the item i1 to the checklist c1 with a text
    Then the checklists service keeps the item i1
    And the checklists service returns the item i1

  @g5 @r5
  Scenario: Add an item without a text
    Given an item i1
    And a checklist c1
    When the person adds the item i1 to the checklist c1 without a text
    Then the checklists service refuses this request
    And the checklists service names the text

  @g6 @r6
  Scenario: Add an item to a missing checklist
    Given a checklist c1
    And the checklist c1 does not exist
    And an item i1
    When the person adds the item i1 to the checklist c1
    Then the checklists service refuses this request
    And the checklists service names the checklist c1

  @g7 @r7
  Scenario: Check an item off
    Given an item i1
    And the status of the item i1 is `open`
    When the person checks the item i1
    Then the checklists service keeps the item i1
    And the checklists service completes this request

  @g8 @r8
  Scenario: Check an item already checked
    Given an item i1
    And the status of the item i1 is `checked`
    When the person checks the item i1
    Then the checklists service refuses this request
    And the checklists service names the item i1

  @g9 @r9
  Scenario: Check a missing item
    Given an item i1
    And the item i1 does not exist
    When the person checks the item i1
    Then the checklists service refuses this request
    And the checklists service names the item i1

  @g10 @r10
  Scenario: List a checklist
    Given a checklist c1
    When the person lists the checklist c1
    Then the checklists service returns the item i1
    And the checklist c1 has the item i1

  @g11 @r11
  Scenario: List a missing checklist
    Given a checklist c1
    And the checklist c1 does not exist
    When the person lists the checklist c1
    Then the checklists service refuses this request
    And the checklists service names the checklist c1

  @g12 @r12
  Scenario: Browse the checklists
    Given a checklist c1
    And a checklist c2
    When the person browses
    Then the checklists service returns the checklist c1
    And the checklists service returns the checklist c2

  @g13 @r13
  Scenario: Browse the items left to check
    Given a checklist c1
    And the checklist c1 exists
    And an item i1
    And the checklist c1 has the item i1
    And the status of the item i1 is `open`
    And an item i2
    And the checklist c1 has the item i2
    And the status of the item i2 is `open`
    When the person browses
    Then the checklists service returns the number of items of the checklist c1 whose status is `open`
